releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.69 strengthens TikTok Share for creator-downloadable videos. Short vt.tiktok.com/vm.tiktok.com links are resolved more carefully, TikTok oEmbed is used as a canonical-page fallback, the resolver now reads both current rehydration data and SIGI variants, primes a browser-like TikTok session before the video page request, and carries session cookies into the approved download request. Smart Life still downloads only when TikTok metadata explicitly reports downloads allowed and exposes a download address; otherwise the item remains link-only. Existing Instagram, Library, Gallery, Home, Files, Notes and Price Photos behavior remains unchanged.
